name: St Mary of the Immaculate Conception, Swinton
shortName: St Mary of the Immaculate Conception

boundary.description: From Clifton station in a straight line N to River Irwell. Then E along the river to Agecrofft Road. SE along Agecroft Road, S along Bolton Road, Fairway, S along Highfield Driver, Manchester Road, East Lancashire Road to its junction with Barton Road. Then S by a bee-line to the Folly Brook and along the brook, to the W border of Eccles College, N along that border and by a beeline to and N along Campbell Road, Worsley Road, Partington Lane (B5231), Station Road to Swinton Station and E along the railway. Then N along Pendlebury Road, Bolton Road, Carrington Street and by a beeline through Silverdale to Rake Lane, including Dewes Avenue estate. Then E along Rake Lane, Lumns Lane to the point opposite Clifton Station and by a beeline to the Clifton Station.
